name: Harley-Davidson Sportster 1200 (1988-2003)
engine: 1200 cc air-cooled Evolution V-twin, single carb, solid-mounted, chain or belt final drive
intro: The solid-mount Evo Sportster 1200. A single carb and a lot of vibration, which shakes bolts and brackets loose.

E: Early bikes have a chain final drive, later ones a belt. Check which yours has.
H: The Sportster primary has its own oil. Change engine oil, primary oil and check the transmission oil level.

recallNote: Harley-Davidson has issued several recalls that touch these years. Run your VIN at nhtsa.gov/recalls before you start.
